command:
set -euo pipefail
git fetch origin
git checkout integration/c6-s3-i2c-20260903
git reset --hard origin/integration/c6-s3-i2c-20260903
rm -f sdkconfig.old
[ -z "$(git status --short)" ]
[ "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "48d20ed7e17107a3d1378a394b12b5382ae58a49" ]
git fetch origin agent-control
git show origin/agent-control:.agent/scripts/20260903-c6-generic-zigbee-phase5-onoff-v1.py > /tmp/c6-phase5-onoff-v1.py
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p = Path('/tmp/c6-phase5-onoff-v1.py')
s = p.read_text()
old = '''replace_once(
    "tests/host/test_gateway_link_control.c",
    "        GATEWAY_LINK_FEATURE_PERMIT_JOIN | GATEWAY_LINK_FEATURE_CAPABILITY_PROFILE));",
    "        GATEWAY_LINK_FEATURE_PERMIT_JOIN | GATEWAY_LINK_FEATURE_CAPABILITY_PROFILE |\n        GATEWAY_LINK_FEATURE_COMMANDS));",
)
# replace second identical expected feature occurrence after first replacement
replace_once(
    "tests/host/test_gateway_link_control.c",
    "        GATEWAY_LINK_FEATURE_PERMIT_JOIN | GATEWAY_LINK_FEATURE_CAPABILITY_PROFILE));",
    "        GATEWAY_LINK_FEATURE_PERMIT_JOIN | GATEWAY_LINK_FEATURE_CAPABILITY_PROFILE |\n        GATEWAY_LINK_FEATURE_COMMANDS));",
)
'''
new = '''text = read("tests/host/test_gateway_link_control.c")
old_features = "        GATEWAY_LINK_FEATURE_PERMIT_JOIN | GATEWAY_LINK_FEATURE_CAPABILITY_PROFILE));"
new_features = "        GATEWAY_LINK_FEATURE_PERMIT_JOIN | GATEWAY_LINK_FEATURE_CAPABILITY_PROFILE |\n        GATEWAY_LINK_FEATURE_COMMANDS));"
if text.count(old_features) != 2:
    raise SystemExit(f"expected two control feature masks, got {text.count(old_features)}")
write("tests/host/test_gateway_link_control.c", text.replace(old_features, new_features, 2))
'''
if old not in s:
    raise SystemExit('phase5 generator fix marker missing')
p.write_text(s.replace(old, new, 1))
PY
python3 /tmp/c6-phase5-onoff-v1.py
python3 tests/host/test_no_embedded_nul.py
git diff --check
git diff --stat
